prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — quick question first: do you want an indoor UV (tanning bed) salon or a spray/tanning booth (sunless) salon? Any location or budget preferences inside Tyler?

A note on recommendations: I don’t have live web access right now, so I can’t pull current ratings or hours. If you tell me which type you want and your ZIP or neighborhood, I can (a) give likely top options based on common chains and known local practices up to mid‑2024, or (b) give a short, tailored search checklist and a call/email script so you can find the best place near you quickly.

If you want to decide yourself, use this quick checklist for choosing the best tanning salon:
- Ratings & recent reviews: aim for 4.0+ with recent reviews mentioning cleanliness and results.
- Cleanliness & hygiene: spotless beds/rooms, fresh towels, sanitizing between clients.
- Equipment quality: newer beds or high‑pressure/low‑pressure options for even color; for spray tans, professional booths or certified technicians and reputable solutions (e.g., VersaSpa, Mystic, or DHA-based products).
- Staff expertise: staff who perform a skin-type assessment and recommend a plan, and certified spray techs.
- Transparency on pricing/memberships: clear package pricing, no surprise fees.
- Safety: eye protection, timers, ventilation, posted safety procedures.
- Trial or guarantee: some salons offer first‑time deals or touch‑up guarantees for spray tans.

Questions to ask (phone or in person):
- “Do you offer spray tans or tanning beds (and which types)?”
- “How old are your bulbs/beds and how often are they serviced?”
- “Do you have certified spray technicians and what solution do you use?”
- “What packages/memberships do you offer and are there any first‑time discounts?”
- “What are your sanitation policies? Do you provide goggles/towels?”

If you tell me spray vs. UV and your neighborhood or ZIP, I’ll give a short list of likely salons and a ready‑to‑use Google/Yelp search string. Which do you prefer?
